headline: United's hubs are running normally; a delay program is slowing Seattle arrivals.

items.text: All seven United hubs reporting so far today are at 84% on time or better, where on time means within 30 minutes of schedule. The hubs are running normally.
The FAA has a ground delay program in effect for flights into Seattle (SEA) until 9:59 PM PT. Those flights are held at their departure airport, with delays averaging 32 minutes and up to 82 minutes.
The FAA's operations plan says a ground stop or ground delay program is possible for flights into Newark (EWR) tomorrow after 10:00 AM ET. It is not in effect now.

traveler_note.text: If you are flying to Seattle, check your flight status before leaving for the airport.
